stable.title: DroidDeck 0.5.0
stable.summary: • Added SteamVR on Meta Quest 3 and 3S from the standard APK. Quest headsets are detected automatically and get their own driver defaults. Immersive SteamVR runs through a native OpenXR activity with headset tracking, Touch controllers and haptics, and SteamVR's dashboard and Steam library work in VR. (@xXJSONDeruloXx, @Jagger15, #642, #910, #733, #853, #905)

preview.title: fix: install Decky Loader from upstream repository
preview.summary: • Point the Decky Loader release lookup at SteamDeckHomebrew/decky-loader instead of the Droid-Deck/decky-loader fork. Upstream now publishes the PluginLoader-arm64 asset that DroidDeck downloads.

recentPreviews.title: fix: install Decky Loader from upstream repository
recentPreviews.summary: • Point the Decky Loader release lookup at SteamDeckHomebrew/decky-loader instead of the Droid-Deck/decky-loader fork. Upstream now publishes the PluginLoader-arm64 asset that DroidDeck downloads.

recentPreviews.title: fix: keep second-screen controls in their own activity
recentPreviews.summary: Thor can kill a running Steam game when its bottom-screen controls are open: the controls are a Presentation dialog, leaving Android's launcher as the resumed activity on that display. A reproduced launcher restart changed DroidDeck to oomscoreadj +50, followed by an LMKD kill. A DroidDeck activity on the second display preserved priority 0 and allowed the same memory profile to load Elden Ring'

recentPreviews.title: feat: auto driver picks come from a Drivers-CI manifest with per-GPU fallbacks
recentPreviews.summary: Step 3 of the Auto driver plan: Auto's pick per GPU now comes from a manifest in Drivers-CI, so the team can change a default or pull a bad build without an app release.

recentPreviews.title: fix: skip DirectAudio setup for Proton queries
recentPreviews.summary: Steam asks Proton tools to translate paths while preparing a launch. Those queries currently stage DirectAudio and overwrite a prefix's Audio choice, which can reset a Pulse selection before the game runs. Limit DirectAudio setup to run, waitforexitandrun and runinprefix.

recentPreviews.title: chore: bump version to 0.5.0 (14)
recentPreviews.summary: Bumps versionCode to 14 and versionName to 0.5.0 for the 0.5.0 release.

recentPreviews.title: fix: only start SteamVR for VR-only games from Steam's library
recentPreviews.summary: A user reported that No Man's Sky kept starting SteamVR and opening in VR without VR mode selected. It still happened after they uninstalled SteamVR in Steam, cleared DroidDeck's data and reinstalled it. Steam kept showing SteamVR's Install button the whole time.

recentPreviews.title: feat: fetch Proton, FEX and the runtimes automatically, and make Linux games run under FEX
recentPreviews.summary: Proton Experimental ARM64, FEX and the Steam Linux Runtimes now download automatically on the first Steam start. Linux games running under FEX start, stay up and take the controller.

recentPreviews.title: Add app-wide 3DoF for VITURE, RayNeo and XREAL glasses and 6DoF for Luma Ultra
recentPreviews.summary: Smart-glasses screen tracking now applies throughout DroidDeck: its menus and settings, non-Steam launchers, desktop sessions, and games share the same configuration. Users can select a tracked virtual screen without starting SteamVR. The branch also adds Luma Ultra positional tracking and optional stereo-assisted controllers, improves glasses display routing, and hardens SteamVR startup and rende

recentPreviews.title: feat: x86-64 client follows DroidDeck-Components' fex.json; fuller x86-64 session logs
recentPreviews.summary: FEX builds can now reach devices without an app release, and x86-64 session logs say more about what ran.

recentPreviews.title: fix: x86-64 Steam client fails without the KDE desktop (FEX r5 bundles libxxhash)
recentPreviews.summary: The x86-64 Steam client failed at its first FEX call on devices without the KDE desktop package:

tests.title: Controller: stick dead zone setting and per-controller profiles (test build, not for merge yet)
tests.summary: This is for testing only, please don't merge it yet. I want a release-signed test build to try on a Galaxy S25 Ultra with an MCON controller, and I haven't run any of it on a device. I'll say when it has been tried and it's ready for review, or I'll close it. Plan and discussion: #580.

tests.title: fix: Steam client responds sooner and its sounds play on time
tests.summary: In the Steam client (Play Steam, Big Picture), moving around felt slow: the focus trailed behind on-screen pad taps and gamepad presses, and the navigation sounds came in late. Two separate causes, both measured on a REDMAGIC Astra (SM8850P, Adreno 840).

tests.title: Steam client download: resumes, retries, shows megabytes, and isn't paused out of sight
tests.summary: A user's first Steam setup never finished on an Honor Pad (Snapdragon 6 Gen 1, metered Wi-Fi with a 14 Mbit/s link). Their log stops at downloading Steam: binslinuxarm64linuxarm64 (2/17). The log was shared 31 s into the session, so nothing had failed yet. The way the download works explains why it never got further.

tests.title: Return to the launcher when a front-end game closes
tests.summary: When a game started from DroidDeck's Games tab (or from another launcher's link) closes, DroidDeck now ends the Steam session cleanly and takes you back to where you launched it, instead of leaving you in Big Picture.

tests.title: feat(phantom-process): add manual override for manual ADB and unreadable setups
tests.summary:
Fixes #468, #207, and #508.
### Problem
On Android 12 (API 31), DroidDeck relies on an app-local SharedPreferences flag (android12-off) set only via its own wireless ADB workflow. As a result, users who apply the phantom process fix externally via PC ADB, or whose devices lack standard Android wireless pairing with a PIN (e.g. LG V50s ThinQ, Huawei/HarmonyOS), remain stuck in UNREADABLE and cannot launch Steam.
### Changes
• Manual Override: Added an explicit "I've already applied the changes" action (PhantomProcessStatus.OVERRIDDEN) that persists the override and immediately unlocks Steam launch.
• Accessible Workflows:

tests.title: feat: launch Easy Anti-Cheat games offline when they support it
tests.summary: Adds a per-game DROIDDECKANTICHEATOFFLINE setting, on by default. For Proton launches, it reads the executable from the adjacent EasyAntiCheat/settings.json and launches that executable directly, so games with an offline mode start without the EAC bootstrapper. Turn it off per game to launch through Easy Anti-Cheat as before. Game and anti-cheat files remain untouched; online modes requiring

tests.title: feat: itch.io store, library and installs for DRM-free Windows builds
tests.summary:
Sign-in: the itch.io API key page sits behind a challenge a WebView cannot pass reliably, so the key is entered by hand and checked against /profile before it is stored.
Library: read from /profile/owned-keys, parsed as the snakecase the server returns, and paged until a page comes back empty.
Store: search through /search/games, shelves from the browser RSS feeds (newest, on sale, free, top rated) with a three-hour cache that keeps the last answer when itch.io rate-limits the request.
Install: the newest Windows upload of the game is streamed into the scratch directory, unpacked, and handed to StoreInstalls, which writes the launcher, the sidebar entry and the Steam shortcut like every other store.
Strings in every locale.

tests.title: Switch the GOG store to GOG's official listing endpoint: fewer requests, the tab now opens in seconds
tests.summary: The GOG tab loaded one game at a time: user/data/games only returns owned ids, so every product needed its own requests for a title, art and details, and the grid stayed empty until the last one came back.

tests.title: a11y: give the button-like clickables a Button role for screen readers
tests.summary: Buttons, tiles, list rows and rail items across the launcher now announce themselves as buttons to a screen reader.

tests.title: feat: tools/device-smoke.sh checks a build on a real device over plain adb
tests.summary: tools/device-smoke.sh checks a build on a real device with nothing but adb, so a change can be tried on a phone or a foldable without python or a rooted device.

tests.title: feat: the unfolded game height can end at a fold line
tests.summary: The sizing rule for putting the game above a fold and the controls below it is now a tested function, so a posture-aware split on foldables can be built on it. Nothing in the app calls it with a fold yet, so there is no behaviour change today.

tests.title: Steam's Wi-Fi and Bluetooth switches show and change the phone's real radios
tests.summary: In Steam's Quick Settings and in its Settings pages (Internet, Bluetooth), Wi-Fi and Bluetooth didn't match the phone. With both on, the QAM showed them off, and flipping either switch changed nothing on the phone.

tests.title: Let a game override the session locale
tests.summary:
Wine takes a game's language and codepage from LANG, and every game runs in
C.UTF-8: the rootfs ships only C.utf8, and the session sets LANG=C.UTF-8 for
the whole guest. A game that reads the locale itself starts with the wrong
language and codepage under that, and will not get past its own startup.

tests.title: fix: hide on-screen controls while the PC keyboard is open
tests.summary: Hide onScreenControls and steamTouchControls while pcKeyboardOpen is active so the touch gamepad overlay does not stay drawn over the on-screen PC keyboard.

tests.title: fix: one refused thermal or power query no longer drops the others from the session report
tests.summary: The session report keeps the thermal headroom and power saver lines when the device refuses the thermal status query, and the other way round; a refused query now shows as "unknown" instead of removing the lines after it.

tests.title: feat: the unfolded controls can stay while a controller is connected
tests.summary: On foldable phones, the Steam Deck controls on the unfolded screen (trackpads and back grips) can now stay visible while a controller is connected. Turn on "Keep them with a controller" under "Controls on the unfolded screen" if you hold your phone in a telescopic controller and still want the on-screen trackpads and back buttons.

tests.title: feat: games show their logo, and store games get one from the store
tests.summary: Games now show their own logo. On the Games page the big title over the game's artwork is replaced by the game's logo when one is available (Steam games, games from GOG, Epic and Amazon, and added games), with the name still shown as text when there is none. GOG, Epic and Amazon installs now also bring the store's own transparent logo, and games that already had a cover (store games, folders with

tests.title: fix: Steam's first frame no longer waits on the client re-downloading itself
tests.summary: The install used to take whichever of Valve's three official client-update hosts answered the manifest first, and that is rarely the fastest one. It now measures all three by fetching the head of the largest component from each, keeps the fastest, and prints the host and the rate it measured, so the log says which one it used.

tests.title: fix: empty App ID no longer crashes the game environment editor
tests.summary: Pressing Done on an empty "Other" App ID field in the game environment editor no longer crashes the app.

tests.title: fix: file provider rejects document ids with . or .. segments
tests.summary: Deleting a file through the system Files app can no longer wipe DroidDeck's whole app folder via a crafted path.

tests.title: fix: file manager selection actions respect the search filter
tests.summary: Select all, Copy, Cut and Delete in the file manager now act only on the files the search is showing.

tests.title: fix: Steam Touch labels no longer corrupt the controller config
tests.summary: A quote, backslash or line break typed into a Steam Touch button label no longer breaks the saved controller config.

tests.title: fix: added-games scan keeps games like Reach, Breach, Crashday and Observer
tests.summary: Scanning a games folder no longer hides games whose exe names happen to contain words like eac, crash, report or server.

tests.title: fix: paste bar ignores taps while a paste is running
tests.summary: Tapping the file manager's paste bar again during a paste no longer starts a second, overlapping copy or move.

tests.title: fix: file manager copy/move keeps symlinks
tests.summary: Copying or moving a folder in the file manager now keeps the symbolic links inside it.

tests.title: fix: a slow folder listing no longer replaces the folder being shown
tests.summary: Moving quickly between folders in the file manager no longer ends up showing the wrong folder's contents.

tests.title: fix: cancelling a paste stops the copy and keeps a move's source
tests.summary: Tapping Cancel during a file manager copy or move now actually stops it.

tests.title: fix: third-party GitHub mirrors only serve downloads with a trusted digest
tests.summary: Downloads that come with no SHA-256 to check against are no longer fetched through third-party GitHub mirrors. A mirror can no longer hand DroidDeck a swapped AppImage or Windows component.

tests.title: fix: Steam Controller (Triton) output/feature reports are no longer overwritten unread
tests.summary: Back-to-back output and feature reports from games or Steam to a BLE Steam Controller (haptics, settings writes) are no longer silently dropped.

tests.title: fix: a Linux runtime update keeps imported apps and catalog AppImages
tests.summary: Updating the Linux runtime no longer deletes imported AppImages, script apps and catalog emulator AppImages.

tests.title: Fix: Keep Android library names visible in diagnostic logs
tests.summary: Android HIDL library names such as android.hardware.graphics.mapper@4.0.so matched the email scrubber, so dependency failures became library "<redacted:email>" not found. Preserve these names only in library "..." not found loader diagnostics, including /vendor/ and /system/ paths. Generic text remains subject to email redaction.

tests.title: fix: shared session logs are always scrubbed, whatever their size
tests.summary: Every file in a shared session-log zip is now scrubbed. Large logs and logs with a stray NUL byte no longer go out raw.

tests.title: feat: detailed adds startup step times and game logs, and the diagnostics page has a log level
tests.summary:
The diagnostics page now has a log level under "Session logs", shown only while session
logs are on. Standard is what ships today. Detailed adds:

tests.title: fix: manual cloud-save upload/download no longer reports a skipped sync as success
tests.summary: Manual cloud-save Upload and Download now tell the user when nothing was synced, instead of showing a success message.

tests.title: feat: Better boot movies system; Added steamdeckrepo support
tests.summary:
• Installed: the “Installed movies” row has a Browse button. It opens a list with a cover for each movie and the current one highlighted. The list re-reads every 2 seconds, so a movie picked or removed inside Steam shows up.
• Import: the same import as before. Imported movies now go into Steam’s own movies folder, so Steam lists them too.
• SteamDeckRepo: search, device filter (all, Steam Deck, Steam Machine), and Trending / Most downloaded / Most liked / Newest tabs. Each page shows 12 movies, with Previous and Next buttons. Install downloads the movie, and the button turns into Use.
• Sound: the on/off toggle, plus a volume slider and a “Length” slider. I read your “seconds slide” as how many seconds of the movie play, from 1 s up to the movie’s full length. Tell me if you meant something else.
• The Adjust logo hint now reads “This exact spot can differ by a few pixels.”

tests.title: fix: run x86 Proton under FEX in the Steam runtime it requires
tests.summary: x86-64 Proton (e.g. Proton Experimental / 11) run through droiddeck-fex never got past startup on the Thor. Three separate problems, all in the FEX launch path:

tests.title: fix: an interrupted package install can no longer break the Linux runtime
tests.summary: A tester's Thor stopped starting Steam (Exit status 134) after the app was closed during a desktop install. Restarting did not help; only reinstalling the app did, which cost them every game.

tests.title: Fix direct-touch right-click and Steam Touch mode restoration
tests.summary: Addresses #628 by adding long-press right-click to Direct Touch (including Steam Touch’s direct mode) and restoring the saved touch mode when Steam Touch is disabled; all 10 focused tests pass, with device validation pending.

tests.title: fix(ci): give unit tests a 2 GB heap
tests.summary: Unit tests on main and on open PRs fail with java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space part way through testReleaseUnitTest. Examples: the main push run 39156692801, #979, and the fix/touch-gestures-628, fix/dex-session-visibility and fix/skip-directaudio-for-steam-iscript branches. The test that fails changes from run to run (SteamHomeHeadsetTest, GlassesMenuCaptureTest, ...), and

tests.title: fix: ignore uinput- system virtual input devices in controller detection
tests.summary: Ignore kernel uinput- / uinput virtual input devices in PadBridge so vendor virtual input nodes (such as uinput-xiaomi on Xiaomi HyperOS 3) do not claim Player 1 (slot 0) or keep anyControllerConnected() permanently true.

tests.title: Keep visible external-display sessions running
tests.summary: Use the session Activity’s display power when suspending or resuming, preventing handset screen-off from pausing visible DeX sessions (#586, #741); Android 26/28/29/33 regressions and CI pass, and the signed build passed Thor secondary-display visibility and sleep/wake checks, with Samsung hardware validation pending.

tests.title: feat: target Android API 36
tests.summary: Moves the app from targetSdk 28 to targetSdk 36 (compileSdk 34 → 36).

tests.title: fix(session): prevent overlapping startup and teardown
tests.summary: Users reported Steam appearing offline. Logs showed Session Replaced after successful sign-in, while downloads still worked. This PR prevents overlapping local sessions, one possible cause, but does not establish the cause of those reports.

tests.title: Accessibility tab: install and enable Orca in every Linux session
tests.summary: Adds an Accessibility tab to the launcher's front-end rail: an introduction to Orca (the GNOME screen reader), an install button, an open-settings button and a master switch that defaults on after install.

tests.title: Rumble: reliable controller motors, Deck haptics, optional Razer Kishi USB rumble; Kishi L4/R4 as Deck back grips
tests.summary: ﻿Fixes the rumble part of #219 / follow-up to #242. Reported in the DroidDeck Discord #bug-reports forum (Kishi V3 Pro on a Galaxy S26 Ultra), with logs there.
